purpose: Form AOC-4 is used by companies to file financial statements and other documents with the Registrar.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the financial statements and other documents.
File the financial statements with the Registrar together with Form AOC-4 or other applicable forms.
Attach the respective attachments in portable document format as required.
checklist: Signed financial statements duly authenticated as specified in section 134 of the Act, including Board report, auditors report and other documents in PDF format
attachments: Copy of signed financial statements duly authenticated as specified in section 134 of the Act (including Board's report, auditors' report and other documents) in PDF format
watch: Ensure proper form selection such as AOC-4, AOC-4 CFS, AOC-4 XBRL, AOC-4 NBFC (Ind AS), or AOC-4 CFS NBFC (Ind AS) based on company type.
